svg.title: Direct eBPF: one new round vs historical references

cc:Work.dc:title: Direct eBPF: one new round vs historical references
cc:Work.dc:description: c1 / P1; 32 B hot key / 128 B value; pool; no persistence; -O2 -g. Bars: medians; dots: raw rounds. 2026-11-19 references retained; direct run: 2026-11-20. No concurrent control rerun or causal claim. Visibility probes are outside throughput timing and include write/read RTT plus 1 ms polling; not one-way latency.

g.text: Separate 1,000 serial visibility probes per round
Direct eBPF: one new round vs historical references
c1 / P1; 32 B hot key / 128 B value; pool; no persistence; -O2 -g. Bars: medians; dots: raw rounds.
2026-11-19 references retained; direct run: 2026-11-20. No concurrent control rerun or causal claim.
Visibility probes are outside throughput timing and include write/read RTT plus 1 ms polling; not one-way latency.
